name: dataviewer
description: Web-based dataset analysis and annotation tool for robot demonstration datasets

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix ../.. ci && npm --prefix ../.. run build --workspace robotic-training-data-tool
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && uv run --frozen --extra dev --extra analysis --extra export pytest -o pythonpath=../../..
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run --frozen --extra dev ruff check src/
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.validate:backend: cd backend && uv run --frozen --extra dev ruff check src/ && uv run --frozen --extra dev --extra analysis --extra export pytest -o pythonpath=../../..
scripts.validate: npm run validate:backend && npm run validate:frontend
scripts.validate:fix: cd backend && uv run --frozen --extra dev ruff check src/ --fix && npm --prefix ../../.. run lint:fix --workspace robotic-training-data-tool && npm --prefix ../../.. run format:fix --workspace robotic-training-data-tool && npm --prefix ../../.. run validate --workspace robotic-training-data-tool
